key_gap: vs baseline: the human reads the O6 hedge ('good knife but I'm careful') as the decisive fear cue and lets O1 falsify the survey's 'sharper' claim directly, all in one empathic pass; the v5 AI reached the same P2 decision but parked O1's edge-geometry implication as a secondary check and leaked survey weights into its criteria. The routed run (m070 evidence-weighted SWOT first-class + m003 inversion gate + m019 red-team check + insight pass) graded the survey as weak proxy evidence before any criteria were set, promoted O1 to a first-class failure category with an instrumented re-sharpen co-measurement, and reached the same decision plus comparable reframes (I1: 'sharper' and 'dull by week 2-3' are the same complaint in two languages; I2: the redesign risk is the handle). The residual gap is only the human's single-pass empathic synthesis.
learning_signal: On user-observation cases with conflicting evidence, the survey-vs-observation conflict must be graded as evidence BEFORE any decision criteria are set (m070 move: stated preference = proxy/weak, behavior-coded rows = strong), and the observation row that contradicts the survey (O1: re-sharpen complaints despite a sharp factory edge) must become a first-class hypothesis with an instrumented measurement, not a parked check — the routed gate structure is what converts the reframe into a testable spec rather than a narrative.
suggested_improvement: Keep m070-style evidence grading as the standing first move on any product redesign with conflicting evidence sources; require that the contradiction row (O1-class) is either a testable hypothesis or an explicit residual in the packet (m003 inversion item 5 + m019 vector 1 deliver this); the insight pass already generates the reframe the human produces by empathy — keep S2 mandatory as the packet gate.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style failed by design — user words as requirements, physics never entered the loop, and the verbatim quote ('it cools down while I pour') was re-transcribed into the wrong 'hotter' frame. The dual-route (m094 critical reading + m033 controlled experiment design, m100 falsification frame, tempo mode for the deadline) made the reframe structural: the 73% claim interrogated as a survey artifact, the verbatim quote decoded at the measurable-variable level (decay, not max temperature), the 'hotter' spec falsified as untestable with this hardware (100 °C ceiling, 15 A breaker), and the final cycle pre-registered as an experiment (intervention, control, blinding, exact thermocouple outcome ±1.5 °C) with the element-upgrade branch priced and rejected.
learning_signal: On physics-bound consumer products, technical constraints are the decision driver and must be screened before any empathy/prototype loop spends a cycle (P5 constraint screen); a stated need that maps to an infeasible spec ('hotter') is framing evidence, not a requirement — decode user language at the measurable-variable level; the dual-route of critical-reading + experiment-design is the correct synthesis for survey-vs-physics conflicts, and the m100 move (the stated need is unfalsifiable with this hardware) is what kills the trap cleanly.
suggested_improvement: Make the constraint screen a standing gate before any prototype-cycle spend on physical products; pre-register the acceptance rule for the final cycle (m033 contract: intervention, control, randomization, blinding, exact outcome measure) so the last cycle is decisive either way; keep tempo mode on deadline decisions — the verdict commits at DO, not re-litigated at review (the human-style failure is exactly the re-litigation against the user's words).
